description: Fast-path completion signal, shared by every loop that writes an agent-outcomes artifact. PostToolUse fires after every tool call in the loop's session; the hook cheaply checks whether that call just posted a comment carrying an <!-- agent-outcome:<routine> --> marker, and if so forwards the raw JSON on a best-effort, non-authoritative path (AGENT_OUTCOMES_ENDPOINT, once one exists — logs only until then). Never the authoritative signal: the GitHub write the loop already made is. See docs/agent-orchestration/11-outcome-artifact.md in umbraco-mcp-ops.
